scoring_justification: All headline quantities can be recomputed from the agent's raw CSV artifacts: equilibrium densities checked against paper values, Laplace law slope recomputed from drop data, domain growth exponent recomputed from domain size table.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference equilibrium densities and growth exponent from paper; structural relation for Laplace law.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Fig.1 and Fig.5 for densities (0.319 and 1.804 at θ'=0.85); Fig.6 for growth exponent 0.70; Laplace's law expects linear relationship with slope ~1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from the paper's text/figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported results used as hidden gold for comparison.

outputs.description: Equilibrium co-existing densities at reduced temperature 0.85.
Pressure difference vs α/R for drops of various radii.
Domain size over time from spinodal snapshots.
Fitted growth exponent n from power law.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are re-derived by the checker against hidden gold values from the paper. No gold values or tolerances are revealed. The checker recomputes metrics from raw artifacts.

steps.description: Check that liquid and gas densities are within tolerance of paper reference (1.804 and 0.319) at temperature 0.85.
Recompute linear relationship between pressure difference and α/R and verify slope close to 1.

recompute_config.compute: delta_p = inside_pressure - outside_pressure; alpha_over_radius = surface_tension_coefficient / drop_radius

steps.description: Recompute power-law exponent from domain sizes between 20 and 128 grid cells and compare to paper reference (0.70).
Compare the reported exponent text to the paper reference 0.70 within tolerance 0.05.
